verdict.rationale: Community reports describe a 'Portable Computer' variant that runs Perplexity's agent harness locally, but only on a user-supplied NVIDIA DGX Spark (comm-2, comm-8). It remains closed source, requires a Pro or Max subscription (comm-3), and a Perplexity orchestrator still decides what escalates to the cloud (comm-1), so it is not a true self-hosted deployment. The first-party docs in the pack describe only the cloud-hosted service and its OAuth-gated hosted MCP endpoint. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a self-hosted or local deployment, operation independent of Perplexity's cloud and accounts, support for hardware other than the DGX Spark, open-source or deployable artifacts, and hands-on corroboration of a local install.
